title: Scikit-fingerprints: Python library for scikit-learn compatible molecular fingerprints and chemoinformatics
abstract: arXiv:2608.02027v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present scikit-fingerprints, a comprehensive, fully scikit-learn compatible library for molecular machine learning in Python, based on RDKit. Molecular fingerprints and related functionalities are workhorses of chemoinformatics, yet the widely used open-source frameworks are not compatible with the wider Python machine learning ecosystem based on scikit-learn conventions. scikit-fingerprints closes this gap, bringing molecular fingerprints, molecular filters, similarity and distance measures, applicability domain estimation, data splitting strategies, and more under a single, familiar interface. Scikit-learn compatibility means that an entire chemoinformatics workflow, from a raw SMILES string to a deployable model, can be assembled from composable building blocks and can reuse the mature tooling of the surrounding ecosystem. translated_title: Scikit-fingerprints：兼容scikit-learn的分子指纹与化学信息学Python库
translated_abstract: 我们推出了scikit-fingerprints，一个基于RDKit的、功能全面且完全兼容scikit-learn的Python分子机器学习库。分子指纹及相关功能是化学信息学的核心工具，然而广泛使用的开源框架与基于scikit-learn约定的更广泛的Python机器学习生态系统并不兼容。scikit-fingerprints填补了这一空白，将分子指纹、分子过滤器、相似性与距离度量、适用域估计、数据划分策略等功能整合到统一且熟悉的接口之下。scikit-learn兼容性意味着整个化学信息学工作流程——从原始SMILES字符串到可部署的模型——都可以由可组合的构建模块组装而成，并能复用周边生态系统中成熟的工具。底层的RDKit代码使其对于自定义化学信息学用例既熟悉又易于扩展。我们……
tldr: scikit-fingerprints是一个基于RDKit、完全兼容scikit-learn的Python化学信息学库，将分子指纹、分子过滤、相似性度量、适用域估计和数据划分等功能整合到统一接口中，使从SMILES字符串到可部署模型的完整工作流能够复用成熟的Python机器学习生态工具。
en_tdlr: scikit-fingerprints is an RDKit-based Python library fully compatible with scikit-learn that unifies molecular fingerprints, filters, similarity measures, applicability domain estimation, and data splitting under a single interface, enabling complete chemoinformatics workflows from raw SMILES to deployable models to leverage the mature Python machine learning ecosystem.
